body: It's yet another classloading issue with kotlin... it can't read the Avro / Protobuf classes.
Any chance you can add a sample of the working Mutiny version vs the non-working Kotlin version?

@geoand Something like this: https://github.com/scherrsasrf/quarkus-issue-33308
POSTing to http://localhost:8080/movies a JSON like this:
```
{
	"title": "test-movie",
	"year": 1990
}
```
Prints the following to the console:
`Received 'test-movie' from 1990`

There's also a commented out suspend version in this file: https://github.com/scherrsasrf/quarkus-issue-33308/blob/main/src/main/kotlin/org/acme/kafka/KotlinConsumer.kt

Trying to start with that code already prints the following message, indicating that something different is happening suddenly:
```ERROR [io.qua.run.Application] (Quarkus Main Thread) Failed to start application (with profile [dev]): java.lang.IllegalArgumentException: The attribute `value.deserializer` on connector 'smallrye-kafka' (channel: movies-from-kafka) must be set```

We use `io.confluent.kafka.serializers.KafkaAvroDeserializer` in our specific case, which then results in the reported error.
I hope this helps :)
I checked this real quick and it I am pretty sure we can fix it. I'll take a closer look later on todat or tomorrow.

issue.title: Properly handle Kotlin suspend methods in Reactive Messaging Kafka
